draft.weaknessQuote: Plays on slender legs and lacks block-sustain strength.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.18, the 95th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 6th of 18 at TE. He went 73rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jordan Thomas. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 598 receiving yards in 2021, 6th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 19 career games and 3 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2022. Weak spots: team target share 0.6% (8th percentile), approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 4 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
